identity_policy.principle: Brand name, product name, and exact model designation are always retained separately.
identity_policy.reason: Pakistan's solar market frequently mixes brand names, product/series names, model numbers, reseller names, and variant names. Records must preserve the exact naming found in each source so similarly named or differently rebranded products are not incorrectly merged.
rules: Never use the model number as a substitute for the brand or product name.
Never merge two records solely because their product names look identical.
Never assume two records are the same because they have similar specifications.
Preserve exact manufacturer/reseller spelling and capitalization in source evidence.
Store normalized names separately from source names.
Record every known alias, series name, reseller name, and alternate model designation.
If the exact model cannot be established, keep the record separate and mark the model as unknown rather than guessing.
A possible rebrand/OEM match must be represented as a relationship with evidence, not as a replacement of the original identity.

records.notes: Initial record. Specifications and OEM relationship must be verified against primary documentation.
Exact model designation must be established from documentation/label evidence before treating this as uniquely identified.
